page: Pin programs an airline orders with its A380s

page.label: Weight unit
page.desc: Unit for weights in the EFB.

page.label: Weight variant
page.desc: Certified maximum weights. Change with the aircraft parked.

page.label: Operator
page.desc: Applies an airline’s engine type and rating. Auto follows the livery.

page.label: Registration
page.desc: Aircraft registration. Empty uses the livery.

page.label: MSN
page.desc: Manufacturer serial number. Empty uses the livery.

page.label: SELCAL
page.desc: SELCAL code (AB-CD). Empty uses the livery.

page.label: Engine type
page.desc: Trent 900 or GP7200. Reload the aircraft after changing.

page.label: Engine rating
page.desc: Take-off rating. Change with the engines shut down.

page.label: Derated thrust
page.desc: Offers take-off and climb derates on the MFD PERF page.

page.label: Takeoff derate levels
page.desc: Thrust cut for D01 to D05, in percent.

page.label: Climb derate levels
page.desc: Thrust cut for climb D01 to D05, in percent.

page.label: Noise abatement departure
page.desc: Sets the FMS thrust reduction and acceleration heights.

page.label: Take-off config policy
page.desc: Flap setting the take-off calculator starts with.

page.label: Take-off thrust policy
page.desc: Thrust type the take-off calculator starts with.

page.label: Packs for take-off
page.desc: Pack setting the take-off calculator assumes.

page.label: Landing config policy
page.desc: Flap setting the landing calculator assumes.

page.label: Landing autobrake policy
page.desc: Autobrake for landing distances. All shows every mode.

page.label: Reverser credit on landing
page.desc: Whether landing distances count reverse thrust.

page.label: Standard passenger weight
page.desc: Mass per passenger. Applies when the aircraft loads.

page.label: Standard bag weight
page.desc: Mass per checked bag.

page.label: Thrust reduction height
page.desc: FMS default, above the runway.

page.label: Acceleration height
page.desc: FMS default, above the runway.

page.label: Engine out acceleration height
page.desc: FMS default after an engine failure.

page.label: ILS source
page.desc: Uses scenery ILS data instead of navdata. Applies on reload.

page.label: Baro linking
page.desc: Which barometric settings follow each other.

page.label: Knob acceleration
page.desc: Turning the FCU knobs quickly changes the value in larger steps.

page.label: Initial baro unit
page.desc: Pressure unit the altimeters start in.

page.label: ISIS baro in inHg
page.desc: The ISIS shows pressure in inHg.

page.label: ISIS metric altitude
page.desc: The ISIS shows altitude in metres.

page.label: Extended lat/lon format
page.desc: Coordinates with decimal minutes on the MFD.

page.label: RMP VHF spacing
page.desc: Frequency step of the radio panels.

page.label: Passenger signs
page.desc: Legend on the overhead signs switch.

page.label: Satcom antenna
page.desc: Satcom datalink installed for ATC messages.

page.label: Automatic callouts
page.desc: Radio height callouts on approach. 500 or 400 stays on.

page.label: Sync first officer EFIS
page.desc: First officer EFIS and audio controls follow yours.

page.label: Show ECL softkeys
page.desc: Softkeys on the EWD electronic checklist.

page.label: OANS performance mode
page.desc: Simpler airport map for a higher frame rate.

page.label: Automatic step climb
page.desc: The FMS climbs to the next cruise level itself.

page.label: Pause at top of descent
page.desc: Pauses X-Plane before the FMS top of descent. Press P to resume.

page.label: Pause distance before T/D
page.desc: How far before top of descent to pause.

page.label: Master
page.desc: Overall aircraft volume.

page.label: Engines
page.desc: Engine volume.

page.label: Gear, flaps and touchdowns
page.desc: Gear, flaps and touchdown volume.

page.label: Wind, rain and thunder
page.desc: Wind, rain and thunder volume.

page.label: Cockpit ambience and levers
page.desc: Cockpit ambience and lever volume.

page.label: ATC chatter
page.desc: ATC chatter volume.

page.label: Cabin announcements
page.desc: Cabin announcement volume.

page.label: Chimes, callouts and clicks
page.desc: Chime, callout and click volume.

page.label: Cabin announcements
page.desc: Plays cabin announcements.

page.label: PTU audible in cockpit
page.desc: Lets you hear the PTU from the cockpit.

page.label: Binaural audio (headphones)
page.desc: Positional 3D sound for headphones. Turn off on speakers.

page.label: Co-Pilot Mode
page.desc: The first officer handles callouts, flows and checklists. You fly.

page.label: First officer callouts
page.desc: Calls thrust set, 100 knots, rotate, positive climb and landing calls.

page.label: First officer voice
page.desc: Voice of the first officer.

page.label: First officer SOP callouts
page.desc: Adds 1000 to go, transition and taxi speed calls.

page.label: First officer raises the gear
page.desc: Selects gear up after positive climb.

page.label: First officer after-start and taxi flows
page.desc: Does the first officer items after start and before taxi.

page.label: First officer after-landing flow
page.desc: Does the first officer items after landing.

page.label: Checklist reading
page.desc: Who reads and answers the normal checklists.

page.label: First officer starts the checklists
page.desc: Calls for each normal checklist at its moment.

page.label: Checklist autofill
page.desc: Items the aircraft senses tick themselves.

page.label: Passenger cabin
page.desc: Shows the cabin. Off saves frame rate.

page.label: Cabin lighting
page.desc: Cabin lighting scene. Automatic follows the flight.

page.label: Cabin brightness
page.desc: Brightness of the cabin lighting.

page.label: Boarding rate
page.desc: How fast passengers and cargo board.

page.label: Pilot avatars
page.desc: Shows pilot figures in the cockpit.

page.label: SimBrief user ID
page.desc: Used to import your flight plan.

page.label: SimBrief auto import
page.desc: Imports your flight plan automatically.

page.label: ACARS service
page.desc: Service for ACARS messages.

page.label: Hoppie logon code
page.desc: Your Hoppie ACARS logon code.

page.label: SayIntentions logon key
page.desc: Your SayIntentions logon key.

page.label: Hoppie logon (native datalink)
page.desc: Logon code for the native datalink.

page.label: VATSIM token
page.desc: Network ATIS and controllers when you fly on VATSIM.

page.label: IVAO token
page.desc: Network ATIS and controllers when you fly on IVAO.

page.label: SayIntentions API key
page.desc: CPDLC, PDC and frequency tuning through SayIntentions.

page.label: Online features
page.desc: Allows features that use the internet.

page.label: SimBridge
page.desc: Connects to SimBridge.

page.label: SimBridge location
page.desc: Where SimBridge runs.

page.label: SimBridge IP
page.desc: Address of the PC running SimBridge.

page.label: SimBridge port
page.desc: Port SimBridge listens on.

page.label: Radio receiver usage
page.desc: Navaids use real range and terrain masking.

page.label: Start cold and dark at gates and stands
page.desc: Even when X-Plane starts with engines running.

page.label: Cold and dark start on ground power
page.desc: Starts with ground power connected. Needs a reload.

page.label: Walkaround
page.desc: Fits covers, pins and chocks at a cold start.

page.label: Wheel chocks
page.desc: Shows wheel chocks.

page.label: Safety cones
page.desc: Shows safety cones.

page.label: Refuel rate
page.desc: How fast the aircraft refuels.

page.label: Automatic pushback speed
page.desc: Default speed of the automatic pushback.

page.label: Pushback with controller input
page.desc: Steer the pushback with your controls.

page.label: Screen resolution
page.desc: Sharpness of cockpit screens. Applies after restarting X-Plane.

page.label: Display frame rate
page.desc: Update rate of cockpit screens.

page.label: Draw screens on
page.desc: Integrated leaves the graphics card to X-Plane.

page.label: Display safe mode
page.desc: Most compatible, slower. Use if screens stay black.

page.label: Draw screens on the CPU
page.desc: Uses no video memory, but screens update slowly.

page.label: DMC self test
page.desc: Length of the display self test.

page.label: EFB brightness
page.desc: Brightness of this EFB.

page.label: Coloured METAR
page.desc: Flight category badge and highlighted weather.

page.label: EFB clock
page.desc: Time shown in the top bar.

page.label: Local time format
page.desc: 12 or 24 hour clock.

page.label: Flight progress in the top bar
page.desc: Origin to destination progress bar.

page.label: EFB text size
page.desc: Size of text in this EFB.

page.label: ADIRS align time
page.desc: How long the ADIRS take to align.

page.label: Separate tiller from rudder
page.desc: Steer the nosewheel with the tiller only.

page.label: Roll steers on the ground
page.desc: For sticks without twist grip or pedals.

page.label: Random failures
page.desc: Failures happen at random during flight.

page.label: Failure severity
page.desc: How serious random failures can get.

page.label: Failure rate multiplier
page.desc: Higher means failures come more often.

page.label: Airframe wear and damage persistence
page.desc: Wear and damage carry over between flights.

page.label: Flight data recorder
page.desc: Records flight data.

page.label: Aircraft state
page.desc: Reset clears failures and damage. New airframe also clears wear.

page.label: Replay length
page.desc: Flight time recorded for X-Plane replay. Longer uses more memory.

page.label: Automatic crash reports
page.desc: Collects a report after a crash.

page.label: Streamer mode
page.desc: Hides logon codes and IDs on screen.

page.label: Run systems outside X-Plane
page.desc: A systems crash can’t take X-Plane down. Needs a reload.

page.label: Autoload light presets
page.desc: Loads a lighting preset by time of day.

page.label: Day preset
page.desc: Preset number, 0 for none.

page.label: Dawn and dusk preset
page.desc: Preset number, 0 for none.

page.label: Night preset
page.desc: Preset number, 0 for none.

page.label: State dumps
page.desc: Writes variables to disk for diagnosing problems.

page.label: Dump every N frames
page.desc: Frames between state dumps.

page.label: Dumps kept
page.desc: How many dumps to keep.
